(1) Glycaemia not at goal, the point at which a further agent is added, verbatim from lly_foundayo.csv: in NHANES 2015 to 2018 HbA1c below 7% was achieved in 50.5% of US adults with diabetes (Fang M, Wang D, Coresh J, Selvin E, N Engl J Med 2021;384(23):2219-2228, doi:10.1056/NEJMsa2032271, PMC8385648), so 0.495 are above it. (2) Outside the obesity pool this asset already prices: NCHS Data Brief 516 (Gwira, Fryar, Gu, November 2024, NHANES August 2021 to August 2023, adults 20 and over) gives diagnosed diabetes in 5.2% of adults with BMI under 25, 9.5% at BMI 25 to 29.9 and 16.3% at BMI 30 or more; weighted by the same survey's BMI bands as the book holds them (obesity 40.3%, data/epidemiology.csv; overweight 86,594,086 of 266,978,268 adults = 32.43%, NCHS Health E-Stat 111, data/epidemiology.csv; the remaining 27.27% under 25), 59.35% of adults with diagnosed diabetes have BMI 30 or more, 27.84% are at 25 to 29.9 and 12.81% under 25. 0.495 x (1 - 0.5935) = 0.2012, a pool of 5,432,832 adults
column12: the obesity share is taken out HERE rather than through base_pool_overlap_pct because forecast._risk_patient_layers returns at once on an asset that is not marketed: a pipeline asset sums every indication's patients in full, so an obese adult with type 2 diabetes written into both pools would be counted twice. Assumes glycaemic control does not differ by BMI band and that the type 1 minority shares the type 2 BMI split, neither tested. The BMI 27 to 29.9 band is on the obesity label but not in the book's obesity pool (107,592,242 counts BMI 30 and above), so it stays in this slice and is not double counted

column11: JUDGEMENT, reused verbatim from lly_foundayo.csv, the book's only per-product type 2 capture for an incretin: 0.01 of the eligible slice a year. Its anchor: GLP-1 receptor agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors together reached 13.3% of medicated US adults with type 2 diabetes in NHANES 2017 to March 2020 (Mittman BG et al., Curr Med Res Opin 2024;40(3):377-383, doi:10.1080/03007995.2024.2303413), one product in one of the two classes read at about a seventh of that two-class share
column12: one rate for every incretin claimant in this pool rather than a new judgement per asset. Leans high for a late entrant against semaglutide, tirzepatide and orforglipron already holding the class; leans low in that this slice now carries the overweight band, where weight loss is wanted more than in Foundayo's lean slice. No measured analogue was used. On the book's own convention Mounjaro reads far higher: US revenue of $8,950mm (2024) and $13,651mm (2025) (LLY 10-K 0000059478-26-000013, asset_revenue_regions) at a net $4,419.57 and 64.8% stopping gives about 2.38 million 2025 starts, 9.8% of the untreated diagnosed pool and 22% of the not-at-goal slice; that count carries switching within the class and off-label obesity use, which no free source separates
